component.name: 2ksbox
component.summary: Run Windows 98 and XP as native vintage boxes

description.p: 2ksbox runs Windows 98 and Windows XP the way the machines of the era did: hardware-accelerated period 3D, a CRT shader chain over the guest's own output, and a CD-ROM drive faithful enough for raw dumps of discs you own — copy protection included.

The launcher keeps a library of machines, creates them from reference configurations rather than a QEMU command line, manages a shared shelf of disc images that can be swapped while a guest runs, and takes snapshots. Each machine opens in its own player window, which embeds a patched QEMU in-process for latency.
